description: 专业金融股票行情、电商社媒数据、内容生成、搜索抓取、学术论文与专利信息、地图信息等。只需一次注册便可调用不同领域专业数据，无需逐一配置各类服务，价格相对官方有大幅折扣。目前已覆盖以下领域：金融： 查询 A股、美股股票行情、股价、K线、成交量、公司财务、财报及基本面数据，覆盖基金、ETF、外汇、汇率、比特币和加密货币，辅助股票与公司研究、投资分析和市场跟踪。接入 Tushare、CoinGecko 等金融数据服务。内容生成： 支持 AI 生图、文生图、图生图、商品图（如小红书图）、海报、抠图、文字渲染、图生视频、文生视频、数字人口播、配音、背景音乐与音效生成。聚合字节跳动即梦相关模型 Dreamina 即梦、Seedream、Seedance，以及可灵 Kling、通义千问 Qwen、通义万相 Wan、腾讯混元 Hunyuan、MiniMax／海螺 AI、智谱 GLM、Google Gemini／Nano Banana／Veo、OpenAI GPT Image／Whisper、Stable Diffusion、FLUX、HeyGen、ElevenLabs 等模型与工具，满足图片制作、视频创作和音频处理需求。信息检索： 按关键词开展联网搜索、新闻查询、行业调研和深度研究，获取 SEO 数据、语义搜索结果、网页内容提取与爬取代理服务。接入 Perplexity、Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Linkup 等；支持论文、学术文献、引用关系与专利信息检索，X（Twitter／推特）、YouTube、TikTok 社媒内容与数据查询，以及 GitHub 仓库、代码和开发文档查询。电商： 获取抖音、TikTok Shop、淘宝、天猫、1688、亚马逊、Shopee、Temu 等平台相关数据，通过蝉妈妈、Kalodata、Sorftime 等服务查询商品、店铺、达人、直播及带货表现，辅助国内与跨境选品、供应商查找、市场调研和竞品分析。其他： 提供高德地图 Amap、和风天气 QWeather 等地图与天气服务，支持地点查询、地理编码、全球及本地天气查询，辅助出行规划；支持 OCR 图片文字识别、文档解析、PDF／Word／Excel／PPT 内容提取，并提供影视、招聘等查询。

display.description_en: Access specialized data and services across financial markets, e-commerce and social media, content generation, web search and scraping, academic papers and patents, maps, and more. With a single registration, you can access professional data across multiple domains without setting up each service separately—all at prices substantially discounted from official rates. The platform currently covers the following areas:Finance: Access market quotes, stock prices, candlestick charts, trading volumes, corporate financial data, financial reports, and fundamentals for Chinese A-shares and U.S. stocks. Coverage also includes mutual funds, ETFs, foreign exchange, exchange rates, Bitcoin, and other cryptocurrencies, supporting equity and company research, investment analysis, and market monitoring. Integrated financial data providers include Tushare and CoinGecko.Content Generation: Create AI-generated images, generate images from text or reference images, produce product visuals (such as images for Xiaohongshu posts) and posters, remove backgrounds, and render text in images. Capabilities also include image-to-video and text-to-video generation, digital avatar presenter videos, voiceovers, background music, and sound effects. The platform brings together ByteDance’s Dreamina (Jimeng), Seedream, and Seedance, alongside Kling, Qwen, Wan, Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax / Hailuo AI, Zhipu GLM, Google Gemini / Nano Banana / Veo, OpenAI GPT Image / Whisper, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, and other models and tools for image production, video creation, and audio processing.Information Retrieval: Run keyword-based web searches, look up news, conduct industry research and in-depth investigations, and access SEO data, semantic search results, web content extraction, and scraping proxy services. Integrated providers include Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, and Linkup. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms. Services such as Chanmama, Kalodata, and Sorftime provide insights into products, stores, creators, livestreams, and sales performance, supporting product sourcing and selection for domestic and cross-border markets, supplier discovery, market research, and competitor analysis.Other Services: Access mapping and weather services such as Amap and QWeather, with support for place searches, geocoding, and global and local weather queries to assist with travel planning. Additional capabilities include optical character recognition (OCR), document parsing, content extraction from PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, and searches for film, television, and job-related information.

Use AgentEarth to retrieve papers, news, and reports on the new energy industry and compile credible conclusions.
Use AgentEarth to query influencer-selling data, keyword trends, and competitor trends for the cosmetics category.
Use AgentEarth to help me generate a set of images, videos, and voiceover assets suitable for a new phone launch.
